persona.name: Craving-Control Struggler
persona.pain_en: Food noise and trigger foods make them lose control after one bite, especially when cravings hit later in the day.
persona.desire_en: They want appetite control that feels reliable, easy and consistent without too much effort so they can eat less without constantly fighting themselves.
persona.friction_en: They have had cravings come back after a few days before, so they do not trust willpower-only solutions or short-lived appetite suppression.
persona.proof_needed_en: They need believable proof that hunger and cravings stay lower long enough to create visible progress, backed by real user results and a structured daily routine.
persona.pain_hi: क्रेविंग और ट्रिगर फूड एक बाइट के बाद कंट्रोल तोड़ देते हैं, खासकर शाम को।
persona.desire_hi: उन्हें ऐसा भूख-कंट्रोल चाहिए जो आसान, भरोसेमंद और लगातार लगे।
persona.friction_hi: पहले क्रेविंग कुछ दिनों बाद लौट आई, इसलिए वे सिर्फ इच्छाशक्ति पर भरोसा नहीं करते।
persona.proof_needed_hi: उन्हें भूख और क्रेविंग कम रहने का भरोसेमंद प्रमाण और साफ रूटीन चाहिए।

EN.headline: One Bite Shouldn't Ruin Weight Loss
EN.support_line: A doctor-formulated Ayurvedic routine supports craving control, so eating less feels more manageable after trigger moments.

HI.headline: एक बाइट से वजन घटाना न बिगड़े
HI.support_line: डॉक्टर-फॉर्मुलेटेड आयुर्वेदिक रूटीन क्रेविंग कंट्रोल सपोर्ट करता है, ताकि कम खाना आसान लगे।

persona.name: Digestion-Issue + Weight Combo Seeker
persona.pain_en: Bloating, acidity, constipation, and heaviness make them feel like their gut and their weight problem are tied together.
persona.desire_en: They want to feel lighter in the stomach and on the scale at the same time, not solve one while worsening the other.
persona.friction_en: Generic weight-loss products ignore gut comfort, and digestive discomfort makes it harder for them to stay consistent.
persona.proof_needed_en: They need proof that the system supports digestion as well as appetite control, with believable user stories that mention less bloating and easier progress.
persona.pain_hi: ब्लोटिंग, एसिडिटी, कब्ज और भारीपन उन्हें gut और वजन को जुड़ा हुआ महसूस कराते हैं।
persona.desire_hi: वे पेट और वजन दोनों में हल्कापन चाहते हैं, बिना पाचन असुविधा बढ़ाए।
persona.friction_hi: जेनेरिक वजन-घटाने वाले प्रोडक्ट gut comfort को नजरअंदाज करते हैं।
persona.proof_needed_hi: उन्हें पाचन सपोर्ट, appetite control और आसान progress का भरोसेमंद प्रमाण चाहिए।

EN.headline: Lose Weight Without Fighting Your Stomach
EN.support_line: The guided Ayurvedic kit supports appetite control and gut comfort, so progress does not feel like digestive drama.

HI.headline: पेट से लड़कर वजन न घटाएं
HI.support_line: गाइडेड आयुर्वेदिक किट appetite control और gut comfort सपोर्ट करती है, ताकि progress ज्यादा practical लगे।

persona.name: Wedding/Event Deadline Persona
persona.pain_en: Deadline for the event is approaching and they don't know how to lose weight in a short duration.
persona.desire_en: They want to look visibly lighter and feel comfortable in their clothes before the deadline without doing anything reckless.
persona.friction_en: They cannot afford a crash plan that makes them weak, stressed, or unpredictable right before the big day.
persona.proof_needed_en: They need proof of visible early progress within a clear timeline, plus realistic deadline-driven transformations.
persona.pain_hi: इवेंट की deadline करीब है और कम समय में वजन घटाने का रास्ता साफ नहीं है।
persona.desire_hi: वे event से पहले हल्का दिखना और कपड़ों में आराम महसूस करना चाहते हैं।
persona.friction_hi: वे crash plan नहीं चाहते जो big day से पहले weakness या stress दे।
persona.proof_needed_hi: उन्हें clear timeline में visible early progress का realistic proof चाहिए।

EN.headline: Fit The Outfit Without Crash Dieting
EN.support_line: A 15-day guided routine supports visible progress while keeping the plan practical before your event deadline.

HI.headline: Crash Diet बिना outfit fit करें
HI.support_line: 15-दिन का guided routine visible progress support करता है और event deadline से पहले plan practical रखता है।

persona.name: Busy Professional
persona.pain_en: Meetings, travel, late lunches, and social workdays keep knocking them back to square one.
persona.desire_en: They want visible weight loss without planning their whole life around meal prep, gym slots, or a fragile routine.
persona.friction_en: Most plans feel too high-maintenance for an irregular schedule and fall apart the moment work gets hectic.
persona.proof_needed_en: They need proof the system fits real life with a simple routine, normal-food compatibility, and no dependence on heavy workouts.
persona.pain_hi: Meetings, travel, late lunches और social workdays उन्हें बार-बार शुरुआत पर लौटा देते हैं।
persona.desire_hi: वे meal prep या gym slots के बिना visible weight loss चाहते हैं।
persona.friction_hi: Irregular schedule में ज्यादातर plans बहुत high-maintenance लगते हैं।
persona.proof_needed_hi: उन्हें simple routine, normal food compatibility और real-life fit का proof चाहिए।

EN.headline: Lose Weight Without Rebuilding Your Day
EN.support_line: The kit fits around normal food and busy schedules with guided steps, not a separate life plan.

HI.headline: दिन बदले बिना वजन घटाएं
HI.support_line: किट normal food और busy schedule के साथ guided steps देती है, separate life plan नहीं।

persona.name: PCOD Support Seeker
persona.pain_en: They feel their body gains weight easily, craves more than it should, and does not respond like everyone else seems to.
persona.desire_en: They want believable weight-loss support that feels possible even with PCOD, without being sold a fake cure.
persona.friction_en: They are deeply skeptical of generic advice and hormonal miracle claims because they have heard both too many times.
persona.proof_needed_en: They need doctor-led credibility, explicit no-cure positioning, and relatable result proof from women managing PCOD who still got visible weight loss.
persona.pain_hi: उन्हें लगता है body आसानी से weight gain करती है, cravings ज्यादा हैं और response अलग है।
persona.desire_hi: वे PCOD के साथ भी believable weight-loss support चाहते हैं, fake cure नहीं।
persona.friction_hi: वे generic advice और hormonal miracle claims से skeptical हैं।
persona.proof_needed_hi: उन्हें doctor-led credibility, no-cure positioning और relatable result proof चाहिए।

EN.headline: PCOD Weight Loss Needs More Trust
EN.support_line: Doctor-led Ayurvedic support focuses on cravings, routine, and visible progress without pretending to cure PCOD.

HI.headline: PCOD में वजन घटाना भरोसा मांगता है
HI.support_line: Doctor-led Ayurvedic support cravings, routine और visible progress पर रहता है, PCOD cure claim नहीं करता।
